description: 1. The agent must read SKILL.md to discover the `.env` configuration mechanism and create a `.env` file in the workspace root with `EXCEL_MAX_ROWS=50` and `EXCEL_KEEP_EMPTY_ROWS=false`. 2. The agent must import `ExcelParser` from `excel_parser` (the bespoke skill module) and call `parser.parse_excel()` on all three files (marketing_budget.xlsx, it_budget.xls, hr_budget.xlsm), collecting the structured result dicts with `sheet_count`, `total_cells`, `engine`, and `sheets` fields. 3. The agent must call `parser.parse_excel_to_text()` on each file to produce the proprietary text format (with `=== Excel文件: ===`, `--- 工作表: ---`, and tab-separated numbered rows). 4. The agent must aggregate all results into `audit_report.json` containing at least 3 entries, each with the required schema fields. 5. The marketing_budget.xlsx Q3_Expenses sheet originally has 80 rows; the report must show <=50 rows due to the EXCEL_MAX_ROWS cap. 6. The engine field must reflect the actual parser used (python-calamine, xlrd, or openpyxl).
